context_requirements: Functional voltage-gated sodium channels (e.g., SCN5A, SCN9A, SCN10A) or epithelial sodium channels (SCNN1A/B/G) must be expressed and electrically active.
The cell must depend on sodium channel activity for a transcriptional program; most immortalized lines do not.
For any indirect effect, the drug must engage a secondary target (e.g., PLAU, KCNH2) at 10 µM.
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine lines.
Enrichment of a specific transcriptional signature shared across lines after treatment.
Changes in genes known to be downstream of sodium channel signaling (e.g., immediate early genes) that are not explained by generic stress.
